description:
Do you know which fruit a cashew grows on — and where?

The moment you think "that's just common sense" is the most dangerous one.
The more familiar something is, the less we actually know its true form.

This game is a common-sense quiz where you pick the "real one" from four very similar images.
How a pineapple actually grows, the red liquid a hippo sweats, the true color of Mars, the inside of a pyramid —
100 questions with a twist, on things you thought you knew but get wrong.

Every theme is the "now that you mention it, I'm curious" kind.
The correct image hides among three look-alike decoys.

How to play is simple.
・Read the question
・Pick the one image of four you believe is real
・Stuck? Narrow it down with a hint
・Check the explanation for why it's the answer

The surprise of "Wait, THIS one is real?!"
The realization of "I really was assuming."
Right or wrong, you gain one new fact — so 100 questions just fly by.

So, the "real thing" 99% can't spot — can you pick it out?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
